_comment: The declared realm contract: what other repositories build against (TDD-identity-kernel-001).
Changing a surface listed here is a breaking change under SAD-001 section 11, and a Keycloak
release that stops covering one fails compat/ -- that is what makes the list a contract rather
than a note about what happened to work once.

question_1.meaning: all four surfaces carry principal_id and subject_type through supported mappers
